tools.name: explain_error
tools.description: Paste an error message (Windows, a PC game, or code). Returns a plain-English summary, ranked causes, safe-first fix steps, and the canonical plainerror.com URL. Reuses published or cached answers first. New answers share the website's limits: 10 new answers per IP per day, a site-wide daily AI spen

tools.name: search_fixes
tools.description: Search PlainError's published plain-English error fixes. Uses the same matching as the website search box. Returns titles, one-line summaries, and canonical URLs (at most 10).

tools.name: get_fix
tools.description: Return the full Markdown for a published PlainError page (or the Windows Update error-codes hub). Pass a full plainerror.com URL, a path like /windows/0x80070002-windows-update-error, or a page slug. When the published steps don't resolve an issue, results include an optional paid Guided Fix the use

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: explain_error, search_fixes, get_fix · Public sink: explain_error.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: explain_error, search_fixes, get_fix · Public sink: explain_error

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
